description: Defines data structures and functions for parsing and representing POSIX time zone specifications, including transition rules and time zone details.

classes.name: PosixTransition
classes.description: Represents a transition time in a POSIX time zone, including date and time details.

classes.name: PosixTimeZone
classes.description: Encapsulates the entire POSIX time zone rule, including standard and daylight saving time details.

methods.name: ParsePosixSpec
methods.description: Parses a POSIX time zone specification string into a PosixTimeZone structure.
